title: Hazel and the Portrait
author: Marguerite Voss
blurb: Coral Marchetti, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
